# FoxData DevRel Content Hub

Automated developer content operations hub for the FoxData App Data API — app market data (downloads, revenue, rankings, keyword coverage, search demand) turned into published developer content across Dev.to, X (Twitter), Bluesky, Threads and GitHub.

## What this repository is

- **Content pipeline**: FoxData API market data → AI-written articles & posts → multi-platform publishing
- **Dev.to ops engine**: hourly monitoring, engagement analysis, low-exposure auto-revive, tag rotation
- **Skills**: installable agent skills for Dev.to operations, FoxData content automation, X account automation
- **Docs**: growth playbooks, forum distribution matrices, AI-SEO guidance

## Key pages

- [README](README.md) — overview, quick start, features
- [Dev.to Growth Playbook](docs/devto-growth-playbook.md) — engagement & exposure strategy
- [Developer Forums Distribution Matrix](docs/developer-forums-distribution-matrix.md) — where to share content
- [AI-SEO Content Guide](docs/ai-seo-guide.md) — AI-search citation optimization
- [Matrix Architecture](docs/matrix-architecture.md) — multi-platform automation design
- [X Bridge Deployment](docs/x-bridge-deploy.md) — external X task integration
